assets.label: cyclone clusters
assets.service: classification duty on the grinding circuit

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - field verification of critical safeguard at CY-3210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on CY-3210 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. CY-3210 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 30 October 2013 a planned field verification of CY-3210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the in-service inspection of pressure equipment not effective.
